column1: # Vanilla 26.1.2 natural-spawn tables (per-biome spawners), measured from the
# server jar's own data pack — data/minecraft/worldgen/biome/<biome>.json in
# The biome set is this project's six-biome model (crates/worldgen/biome.rs).
# **`minecraft:mountains` no longer exists in 26.1**: the name was renamed to
# correspondence, not a claim that our `Mountains` covers the same terrain —
# the biome crate itself says its names are "not verified as a mapping".
# Categories other than monster/creature (ambient, axolotls, ...) carry mobs
# this build does not model and are not recorded here. Rows whose mob is not
# one of the eight modeled kinds are recorded anyway; the loader skips them and
# counts them, and the spawn module's tests assert those skip counts, so a
# silently dropped row is a failed test.
